Project brief: Build a React + Bun + Hono application that lets farmers (via smartphone) enter simple daily logs: feed amount (kg), average weight, water‑quality indicators (pH, temperature), and any health notes. The backend stores entries securely and exposes APIs for the AI service. Using an NVIDIA open‑source model (e.g., a time‑series forecasting or anomaly‑detection model) hosted on Nebius Token Factory, the system calculates each flock/pond’s feed‑conversion ratio (FCR), flags deviations from normal ranges, and sends in‑app notifications or SMS alerts when early signs of stress or inefficiency appear. A responsive dashboard visualizes growth curves, FCR trends and risk scores over time. An autonomous agent continuously reviews incoming logs, suggests optimal feed adjustments and highlights outliers for immediate farmer attention. The project targets the Coding & Agentic Engineering track (AI model integration, anomaly detection, agent logic) and the Best Apps & Agents track (farmer‑friendly UI, accessible alerts, dashboard).
